reason: I am loyal to traditional homemade mixer-ground chutney because factory sauces rely on vinegar and preservatives that destroy authentic flavor.
objection: Packaged green chutney always tastes like chemicals and vinegar, never like fresh homemade dhaniya-pudina.
would_change_my_mind: If taste tests and clean ingredient labels convincingly prove it tastes genuinely fresh without sour chemical preservatives.
